# LogEntry

`c.LogEntry` calls the API's LogEntry group. The entries of the systemd journal.

## Methods

| Method                                 | Returns                                | Permission   | Description                      |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------- |
| [`List(ctx, hostname, params)`](#list) | `*Response[Collection[LogEntryEntry]]` | `entry:read` | List the entries of the journal. |

### List

```go
func (s *LogEntryService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	params LogEntryListParams,
) (*Response[Collection[LogEntryEntry]], error)
```

List the entries of the journal.

Runs journalctl --output=json, the newest entries last: the last 100 unless
lines says, of one unit when unit says, since a time when since says, and at a
priority or above when priority says. A priority is its name, such as err or
info. The hand-written log domain read the Debian family only; this reads each
Linux host that has journald.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/log/entry`, and needs the permission
`entry:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

The newest entries, `go run log_entry.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.LogEntry.List(ctx, target, client.LogEntryListParams{})
```

The last entry of one unit at info or above, `go run log_entry.go list-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.LogEntry.List(ctx, target, client.LogEntryListParams{
	Lines:    1,
	Priority: "info",
	Since:    "1 hour ago",
	Unit:     "nginx.service",
})
```
